ei.title: 글의 요지 — 양육은 부모 자신의 내면 성장이다
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고2

fullPassage: Most parents think that if our child would just “behave,” we could stay calm as parents. The truth is that managing our own emotions and actions is what allows us to feel peaceful as parents. Ultimately we can’t control our children or the obstacles they will face ― but we can always control our own actions. Parenting isn’t about what our child does, but about how we respond. In fact, most of what we call parenting doesn’t take place between a parent and child but within the parent. When a storm brews, a parent’s response will either calm it or trigger a full-scale tsunami. Staying calm enough to respond constructively to all that childish behavior ― and the stormy emotions behind it ― requires that we grow, too. If we can use those times when our buttons get pushed to reflect, not just react, we can notice when we lose equilibrium and steer ourselves back on track. This inner growth is the hardest work there is, but it’s what enables you to become a more peaceful parent, one day at a time.

questions.passage: Staying calm enough to respond __________ (constructive) to all that childish behavior requires that we grow, too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 모든 유치한 행동에 건설적으로 반응하기 → constructively (부사)
det.analysis: 동사 respond를 수식하는 자리 → 부사 constructively
det.tip: 동사를 수식하려면 형용사(constructive)가 아닌 부사(constructively)를 써야 한다.

questions.passage: Most parents think that if our child would just “behave,” we could stay calm as parents. The truth is that managing our own emotions and actions is what allows us to feel peaceful as parents. Ultimately we can’t control our children or the obstacles they will face ― but we can always control __________. Parenting isn’t about what our child does, but about how we respond. In fact, most of what we call parenting doesn’t take place between a parent and child but within the parent. When a storm brews, a parent’s response will either calm it or trigger a full-scale tsunami. Staying calm enough to respond constructively to all that childish behavior ― and the stormy emotions behind it ― requires that we grow, too. If we can use those times when our buttons get pushed to reflect, not just react, we can notice when we lose equilibrium and steer ourselves back on track. This inner growth is the hardest work there is, but it’s what enables you to become a more peaceful parent, one day at a time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 우리는 항상 '자신의 행동'을 통제할 수 있다.
det.analysis:
① our own emotions — 우리 자신의 감정 (통제할 수 없는 것으로 언급)
② our own actions — 자신의 행동 ←정답
③ our children — 우리 아이들 (통제할 수 없다고 앞에서 언급)
④ a full-scale tsunami — 대규모 쓰나미 (문맥 부적합)
det.tip: we can always control our own actions = 항상 자신의 행동을 통제할 수 있다

questions.passage: Most parents think that if our child would just “behave,” we could stay calm as parents. The truth is that managing our own emotions and actions is what allows us to feel peaceful as parents. Ultimately we can’t control our children or the obstacles they will face ― but we can always control our own actions. Parenting isn’t about what our child does, but about how we respond. In fact, most of what we call parenting doesn’t take place between a parent and child but within the parent. When a storm brews, a parent’s response will either calm it or trigger a full-scale tsunami. Staying calm enough to respond constructively to all that childish behavior ― and the stormy emotions behind it ― requires that we grow, too. If we can use those times when our buttons get pushed to reflect, not just react, we can notice when we lose equilibrium and steer ourselves back on track. This inner growth is the hardest work there is, but it’s what enables you to become __________, one day at a time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 내면의 성장이 당신을 '더 평화로운 부모'가 될 수 있게 한다.
det.analysis:
① a perfect child — 완벽한 아이 (글의 주제와 반대)
② a calmer storm — 더 잔잔한 폭풍 (문맥 부적합)
③ a more peaceful parent — 더 평화로운 부모 ←정답
④ a stronger obstacle — 더 강한 장애물 (문맥 부적합)
det.tip: enables you to become a more peaceful parent = 더 평화로운 부모가 되게 해준다
